footer: SolidWorks already matches the workbook on record; Update SolidWorks checks it live and puts right anything changed there; gears turned in SolidWorks stay where they are unless something must move. It was built with a configuration per mode (H, N and L), each named as its mode, and saved in H; to switch mode, double-click another mode's configuration in SolidWorks' ConfigurationManager. Drag Sun in SolidWorks and the rest of its train follow. Carrier (the carrier) is axes and planes only, so it has nothing to drag. As read at 06:31, Update SolidWorks leaves your Sprocket-1, Housing-1, Lock3, Keyway in Gear_m1.25_N29 and Groove in Sleeve_m1.25_N17 as they are.
